# Dashkit UI

> Open-source React component library built with Tailwind CSS v4. Copy-paste distribution model giving developers complete source code ownership, minimal runtime overhead, and accessible building blocks.

Dashkit components are installed directly into your repository source code via the CLI. It uses pure Tailwind v4 tokens, CSS variables, and standard React primitives with Framer Motion for micro-interactions.

## Quick Start

Initialize Dashkit in your project:

```bash
bunx carllosnc/dashkit init
```

Add components individually:

```bash
bunx carllosnc/dashkit add button
bunx carllosnc/dashkit add card
bunx carllosnc/dashkit add sidebar
```

## CLI Reference

- `dashkit init [-y] [-c <dir>] [--css-dir <dir>] [--ai-rules [file]] [--no-ai-rules] [-f] [--no-install] [--json]`: Configures `dashkit.json`, installs `dashkit.css` and `utils/`, injects `@import` into the main stylesheet, and generates AI assistant instructions (`AGENTS.md`).
- `dashkit add <components...> [--all] [-o <dir>] [-t] [-f] [--no-install]`: Scaffolds one or more components, resolves dependencies in a single batch, and updates the root `index.ts` barrel file.
- `dashkit info <component> [--json]`: Outputs component exports, dependencies, and TypeScript Props definitions.
- `dashkit list [--installed] [--json]`: Lists all registry components with status.
- `dashkit diff [component] [--json]`: Compares local component files against the upstream registry.
- `dashkit ai-rules [-o <file>]`: Generates or updates AI coding assistant rules in `AGENTS.md` or `.cursorrules`.
- `dashkit doctor`: Verifies CSS imports, dependencies, and directory configuration.
- `dashkit mcp`: Starts the stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants.

## Design Tokens and Theming (`dashkit.css`)

Dashkit uses a two-layer token system in `dashkit.css`: `@theme inline` maps semantic Tailwind utilities (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-card`, `text-primary`, `border-border`) to underlying `:root` and `.dark` CSS custom properties.

### Editable `:root` & `.dark` Variables
- `--ds-bg` / `--ds-fg`: Main application background and foreground text.
- `--ds-card` / `--ds-card-fg`: Card and container surfaces.
- `--ds-popover` / `--ds-popover-fg` / `--ds-popover-border`: Dropdowns, modals, and floating overlays.
- `--ds-primary` / `--ds-primary-fg`: Primary brand action color (`ds-primary-gradient` derives automatically from `--ds-primary`).
- `--ds-secondary` / `--ds-secondary-fg`: Secondary action surface and text.
- `--ds-muted` / `--ds-muted-fg`: Muted backgrounds and secondary/helper text.
- `--ds-accent` / `--ds-accent-fg`: Hover and subtle selection highlights.
- `--ds-border` / `--ds-border-subtle`: Default and subtle dividers/borders.
- `--ds-input-bg` / `--ds-input-border` / `--ds-input-focus` / `--ds-input-fg` / `--ds-input-ring`: Form control tokens.
- `--ds-danger`, `--ds-success`, `--ds-warning`, `--ds-info` (plus `*-fg` pairs): Semantic feedback states.
- `--ds-chart-1` through `--ds-chart-5`: Categorical data visualization palette.
- `--radius`: Master border radius (`0.75rem` default). `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--radius-xl`, and `--radius-2xl` scale proportionally from `--radius` (set `--radius: 0rem` for sharp corners).
- `--ds-pill-radius`: Pill radius for `Button`, `Switch`, `Chip`, `Slider`, and `ProgressBar` (`calc(var(--radius) * 9999)` default; automatically becomes `0rem` when `--radius: 0rem`, or set explicitly e.g. `--ds-pill-radius: var(--radius-md)`).
- `--ds-border-width`: Structural border width for Cards, Buttons, Chips, and Inputs (`1px` default; set to `2px` for Neo-Brutalism).
- `--ds-button-border`: Border color for filled and soft Buttons (`transparent` default; set to `var(--ds-border)` or `var(--ds-primary)` for bordered buttons).
- `--ds-button-shadow`, `--ds-button-outlined-shadow`, `--ds-button-soft-shadow`, `--ds-card-shadow`, `--ds-input-shadow`: Elevation or hard Neo-Brutalist offset shadows (e.g. `3px 3px 0px 0px var(--ds-border)`) or CRT glow shadows.
- `--ds-primary-gradient` / `--ds-danger-gradient`: Optional gradient overrides (set to `none` for flat buttons).

### Dynamic Runtime Theme Attributes
Apply on `<html>`, `<body>`, or any scoped container `<div>`:
- `data-base`: `zinc` (default), `slate`, `gray`, `neutral`, `stone`, `taupe`, `mauve`, `mist`, `olive`.
- `data-primary`: `blue` (default), `violet`, `indigo`, `emerald`, `green`, `rose`, `orange`, `amber`, `cyan`, `teal`, `fuchsia`, `red`, `yellow`, `lime`, `sky`, `purple`, `pink`.
- `data-dark-bg`: `oled` (enables pure `#000000` black background when `.dark` is active).

### 3-Tier AI Customization Protocol
1. **Tier 1 (Global Theme)**: Edit `:root` / `.dark` tokens or `data-base` / `data-primary` in `dashkit.css`. Never scatter inline theme classes across pages.
2. **Tier 2 (Component-Wide Style)**: Edit `cva(...)` variants directly inside `src/dashkit/<Component>/<Component>.tsx`.
3. **Tier 3 (One-Off Instance Override)**: Pass `className` (merged via `cn()`, which resolves `rounded-*` and `bg-none` against `ds-rounded*` and `ds-*-gradient`) or target sub-elements via `data-slot` (`className="[&_[data-slot=label]]:uppercase [&_[data-slot=trigger]]:rounded-full"`).

## Component API Patterns (Compound vs. Prop-Driven)

- **Compound Components (use subcomponents via `children`)**:
  - `Card`: `Card`, `CardHeader` (props: `leftIcon`, `action`), `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`
  - `BentoGrid`: `BentoGrid`, `BentoGridItem`
  - `Tabs`: `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`
  - `Accordion`: `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AccordionContent`
  - `Modal`: `Modal`, `ModalHeader`, `ModalContent`, `ModalFooter`
  - `Drawer`: `Drawer`, `DrawerHeader`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerFooter`
  - `Dropdown`: `Dropdown`, `DropdownTrigger`, `DropdownContent`, `DropdownItem`, `DropdownLabel`, `DropdownSeparator`
  - `Popover`: `Popover`, `PopoverTrigger`, `PopoverContent`
  - `Table`: `TableContainer` (`maxHeight`), `Table`, `TableHeader` (`sticky`), `TableBody`, `VirtualTableBody` (virtualized rows), `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`, `TableCaption`
  - `Navbar`: `Navbar`, `NavbarBrand`, `NavbarLinks`, `NavbarActions`
  - `NavigationMenu`: `NavigationMenu`, `NavigationMenuList`, `NavigationMenuItem`, `NavigationMenuTrigger`, `NavigationMenuContent`, `NavigationMenuLink`, `NavigationMenuViewport`
  - `Sidebar`: `SidebarProvider`, `Sidebar`, `SidebarTrigger`, `SidebarContent`, `SidebarHeader`, `SidebarSection`, `SidebarItem`, `SidebarSubList`, `SidebarSubItem`, `SidebarFooter`
  - `Breadcrumb`: `Breadcrumb`, `BreadcrumbList`, `BreadcrumbItem`, `BreadcrumbSeparator`, `BreadcrumbEllipsis`
  - `Stepper`: `Stepper`, `Step`
  - `Dock`: `Dock`, `DockItem`
  - `ButtonGroup`: `ButtonGroup`, `ButtonGroupItem`
  - `Avatar`: `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`
- **Prop-Driven Components (pass data via props, do NOT invent subcomponents)**:
  - `Select`, `Combobox`: Pass `options={[{ value, label }]}`, `value`, `onChange`, `label`.
  - `Input`, `Textarea`, `DatePicker`, `DateField`, `ColorPicker`, `CopyField`, `OtpInput`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `Switch`, `Slider`: Pass `label`, `description` / `helperText`, `error` directly as props.
  - `TagInput`: Pass `value` / `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `suggestions`, `maxTags`, `allowCustom`, `label`.
  - `FileUpload`: Pass `files` / `onFilesSelected`, `accept`, `maxSize`, `maxFiles`, `multiple`, `label`.
  - `CommandPalette`: Pass `actions` (`[{ id, label, group, onSelect, keywords }]`), `open`, `onOpenChange`, `placeholder`.
  - `StatsCard`: Pass `title`, `value`, `trend`, `trendLabel`, `status`, `icon`, `chart`.
  - `AreaChart`, `BarChart`, `LineChart`, `PieChart`: Pass `data` and `series` props.

## Component Catalog

Complete list of 59 production-ready components. For full API signatures, props tables, and code snippets, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

### Layout & Containers

- [Accordion](llms-full.txt#accordion): A vertically stacked list of headers that reveal associated content areas when clicked.
- [BentoGrid](llms-full.txt#bentogrid): A modular grid layout system for building regular and irregular Bento or Hairline grids while maintaining seamless `1px` shared border coherence across arbitrary column/row spans and responsive breakpoints.
- [Card](llms-full.txt#card): Dashkit's Card is designed as a **composed wrapper**, providing total layout control through granular sub-components.
- [Surface](llms-full.txt#surface): A lightweight, foundational component for creating containers with consistent background variants based on design system states. It provides a clean, borderless surface with no internal padding or margin, serving as a pure visual block.
- [Divider](llms-full.txt#divider): A versatile component used to separate sections of content with horizontal or vertical lines.
- [ScrollArea](llms-full.txt#scrollarea): A minimalist scroll area component that provides theme-aware, custom scrollbars across all browsers and operating systems.

### Navigation

- [Navbar](llms-full.txt#navbar): A premium, responsive navigation header with support for branding, navigation, and action buttons using a flexible composition pattern.
- [NavigationMenu](llms-full.txt#navigationmenu): A premium navigation menu component inspired by modern, high-end dashboards. It features a shared viewport that smoothly moves and resizes to accommodate different content sections.
- [Sidebar](llms-full.txt#sidebar): A versatile and premium navigation sidebar component that supports complex layouts, branding, status indicators, and responsive mobile drawer adaptation out of the box.
- [Breadcrumb](llms-full.txt#breadcrumb): A secondary navigation component that helps users understand their current location in the application hierarchy.
- [Tabs](llms-full.txt#tabs): A performant and premium tabs component with a smooth, fluid indicator animation powered by Framer Motion.
- [Stepper](llms-full.txt#stepper): A progress visualization component for multi-step processes or sequence indicators.
- [Pagination](llms-full.txt#pagination): A functional and responsive component for navigating between large sets of data or views.
- [Dock](llms-full.txt#dock): A fluid, magnified navigation bar inspired by macOS, using Framer Motion for high-fidelity interactive physics.

### Forms & Inputs

- [Button](llms-full.txt#button): A highly customizable button component supporting multiple variants, icons, and loading states.
- [IconButton](llms-full.txt#iconbutton): A premium, specialized button for icon-only actions with customizable variant and rounding options.
- [ButtonGroup](llms-full.txt#buttongroup): The **ButtonGroup** component is used to cluster multiple buttons together in a single, cohesive unit. This is often used for toolbar actions, toggle switches, or navigation. It features a modern, border-aware outlined design with dedicated selection states.
- [Input](llms-full.txt#input): A primitive input component with support for labels, icons, error states, and helper text.
- [Textarea](llms-full.txt#textarea): A multiline text input component with support for labels, error states, and auto-growing height.
- [Checkbox](llms-full.txt#checkbox): A custom-styled checkbox component for binary choices, with support for labels and descriptions.
- [Radio](llms-full.txt#radio): A premium radio button component for single choices from a set, with support for labels and descriptions.
- [Switch](llms-full.txt#switch): A high-performance, premium toggle switch component for binary choices, with support for labels and descriptions.
- [Select](llms-full.txt#select): A high-performance dropdown component for single choices, featuring portalled rendering to prevent layout overflow and full keyboard accessibility.
- [Combobox](llms-full.txt#combobox): A combobox is a flexible select component that allows users to filter a large list of options via a search input.
- [Slider](llms-full.txt#slider): A premium, interactive slider component for selecting a value from a range, featuring smooth animations and real-time feedback.
- [DateField](llms-full.txt#datefield): A premium, HeroUI-inspired input component for entering and editing date values with individual segments for Day, Month, and Year.
- [DatePicker](llms-full.txt#datepicker): A minimal, animated date selection component built with native React and Framer Motion. Ideal for dashboards and forms that require single date selection with a premium look.
- [OtpInput](llms-full.txt#otpinput): A premium input component optimized for One-Time Passwords, featuring automatic focus shifting, digit masking, and full paste support.
- [ColorPicker](llms-full.txt#colorpicker): A premium color picker component that allows users to select from a curated list of presets or provide a custom hex value.
- [CopyField](llms-full.txt#copyfield): A specialized input component designed for displaying read-only text that needs to be copied to the clipboard, such as invite links, API keys, or referral codes.
- [TagInput](llms-full.txt#taginput): A multi-select tag input supporting keyboard navigation (`ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Backspace`, `Delete`), delimiter commits, and autocomplete suggestions.
- [FileUpload](llms-full.txt#fileupload): A drag-and-drop file upload dropzone with file size validation, per-file progress bars, and status indicators.

### Feedback & Overlays

- [Modal](llms-full.txt#modal): A centered, layered dialog component that focuses user attention on critical information or actions.
- [Drawer](llms-full.txt#drawer): A premium panel component that slides in from the edges of the screen, providing a temporary surface for navigation, settings, or details. It uses a compositional pattern to give you full control over the header, content, and footer sections.
- [Dropdown](llms-full.txt#dropdown): An interactive menu that displays a list of actions or options when triggered.
- [Popover](llms-full.txt#popover): A floating container that displays rich content anchored to a trigger element. Popovers are ideal for more complex content than tooltips, such as forms or descriptive text.
- [Tooltip](llms-full.txt#tooltip): A small popup that displays information when a user hovers over an element.
- [Toast](llms-full.txt#toast): A succinct message that provides feedback about an operation in a small, non-intrusive card.
- [Backdrop](llms-full.txt#backdrop): A blurred or semi-transparent full-screen overlay, often used behind modals, drawers, or to dim the background for focus.
- [Spinner](llms-full.txt#spinner): A sleek, high-performance loading indicator built with SVG and CSS animations.
- [ProgressBar](llms-full.txt#progressbar): Animated, fluid indicators for tracking task completion, loading states, or data metrics with high precision.
- [CircularProgress](llms-full.txt#circularprogress): A high-fidelity circular progress indicator built with SVG and Framer Motion. It provides smooth, fluid animations for status monitoring, health metrics, and loading states.
- [Skeleton](llms-full.txt#skeleton): A placeholder component used to mimic the layout of actual content while it is loading.
- [FloatActionMenu](llms-full.txt#floatactionmenu): A premium floating action button that reveals an interactive menu card sliding from right to left.
- [CommandPalette](llms-full.txt#commandpalette): A fast, keyboard-first command menu (`Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`) for triggering actions, searching records, and navigating workspaces.

### Data Display & Metrics

- [Avatar](llms-full.txt#avatar): A versatile component for presenting user profile pictures, with built-in fallback Support and smooth loading transitions.
- [Badge](llms-full.txt#badge): Visual indicators used for counts, statuses, or high-priority labels. Dashkit provides two distinct badge components optimized for different use cases.
- [FloatBadge](llms-full.txt#floatbadge): Visual indicators used for counts, statuses, or high-priority labels. Dashkit provides two distinct badge components optimized for different use cases.
- [Chip](llms-full.txt#chip): A compact, interactive element that represents an input, attribute, or action, inspired by Material Design 3.
- [ListTile](llms-full.txt#listtile): A flexible row component for building lists, menus, and settings panels. Supports leading icons or avatars, a title and subtitle text block, and a trailing slot for actions or indicators.
- [StatsCard](llms-full.txt#statscard): A high-level component for displaying key performance indicators, metrics, and trends at a glance.
- [AnimateNumber](llms-full.txt#animatenumber): A specialized component for creating sleek numeric counters with independent digit animations. It uses a "top-to-bottom" sliding effect for each character, providing a premium and dynamic feel for dashboards and metrics.
- [SystemLogs](llms-full.txt#systemlogs): A terminal-style component for displaying real-time system logs, process outputs, or audit trails with auto-scrolling and status indicators.
- [Table](llms-full.txt#table): A simple, responsive table component for displaying structured data.

### Visualization & Media

- [AreaChart](llms-full.txt#areachart): The **AreaChart** component is a lightweight, responsive data visualization tool built using native SVG and **Framer Motion**. It's designed to be lean, performant, and deeply customizable through theme tokens.
- [BarChart](llms-full.txt#barchart): The **BarChart** component is a powerful, animated data visualization tool built for comparing discrete categories or showing distribution across groups. It supports multiple grouped series, interactive tooltips, and smooth entrance animations.
- [LineChart](llms-full.txt#linechart): The **LineChart** component is a clean, minimal data visualization tool built using native SVG and **Framer Motion**. It's ideal for showing precise trends without the visual weight of an area fill.
- [PieChart](llms-full.txt#piechart): The **PieChart** component is an expressive tool for visualizing categorical distributions. It features interactive segments with tooltips, smooth hover scaling, and supports donut variations via the `innerRadius` prop.
- [ImageExpander](llms-full.txt#imageexpander): A premium component that enables cinematic image expansion with smooth animations, backdrop blur, and caption support.
